description: Hugging Face packages, including models, datasets, and spaces

namespace_definition.note: The namespace is the repository username or organization, if present. It is case sensitive.

name_definition.note: The name is the repository name. It is case sensitive.

version_definition.native_name: revision Git commit hash or tag
version_definition.note: The version is a revision Git commit hash or tag. Tags are case sensitive and must be preserved as-is. Commit hashes are hexadecimal and shall be lowercased in the package URL.

qualifiers_definition.description: The type is the kind of Hugging Face repository: model (default), dataset, or space.
